Khao Sok

One or two nights. Sleep at the lake if you want dawn mist on the limestone. Sleep in the village if you arrive late from Phuket or Krabi.

Lake raftAndaman side
Nights1-2
Get thereVan from Phuket, Krabi, or Surat Thani
SeasonLake shines after rain; trails get slick

Khao Sok sits on the Andaman-side calendar even though the lake is inland. Pair it with Phuket or Krabi, not with Samui, unless you like a long van.

Night safaris and lake canoes are the usual Klook-booked pieces. Raft houses vary in comfort; read the last season's notes.

Common questions

Day trip or overnight?
Overnight. The lake at 7:00 is the reason you came. A day trip is a van and a warm boat.
